name: Locked Forme
desc: A forme locked up in the chase and printed with real bite — blocks of type colour, brass rules, wood-type slabs with punched counters and ornament borders, every face haloed by its own impression as a raking lamp crawls over the deboss, ink squashing out at the edges and starving in the middle of the big faces while the damp stock cockles under the platen.

energy.doc: how hard the platen bites — impression depth, halo strength, ink squash, specular, paper cockle

density.doc: how full the forme is (less furniture, more type) plus how heavily it was rolled — ink weight and haze

speed.doc: rate multiplier on the press cycle and the raking lamp

scale.doc: body size of the type, rules and ornaments

hue.doc: ink hue — 30 is a warm printer's black; carries the stock with it

x.doc: where the lamp pools on the sheet, x

y.doc: where the lamp pools on the sheet, y

act.doc: multi-minute program: bite and inking breathe / a kiss impression, barely there / the rollers are running heavy and the faces fill in

style.doc: aesthetic: warm black on toned laid stock / blind deboss — no ink at all, the form exists only as light in the impression / hot foil on near-black stock, hard specular / an under-inked grey galley proof on newsprint / not a print at all: the metal forme itself, faces raised and raking, locked in dark furniture

seed.doc: deterministic forme — the lock-up, cell contents, line breaks, stock fibre
